full_prompt_en: A square macro-style color photograph fills the frame with part of a freckled face under intense blue, violet, and orange light. There is no separate background; the crop is so close that the eye, cheek, bridge of the nose, and nostril become the entire setting. Across the upper left, dark hair and a heavy brow sweep over a sharp green-gold iris. A tiny white reflection sits on the glossy eye, while the eyelid and lashes hold deep navy shadow. Toward the right edge, a second eye falls out of focus and appears as a soft green circle beyond the sharply rendered nose. The center of the face is washed in saturated electric blue, and scattered freckles remain visible as darker marks across the nose and cheek. A hot orange-red patch glows on the left cheek, broken into tiny textured highlights that reveal pores and irregular skin surface. A narrower orange rim catches the right side of the nose and the near edge of the face. Purple shadows fill the lower left and top, keeping the hot color from spreading across the whole image. The lighting is clearly directional and multicolored: cool blue strikes the central planes, warm light grazes the cheek and nose edges, and the darkest areas collect beneath the brow and around the nostril. The lens holds the near eye and skin texture sharply while letting the far eye soften, creating depth within a very tight crop. The overall composition is intimate and electric, using complementary color light and tactile detail to make one small area of expression feel expansive.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形微距式彩色照片让一张长着雀斑的面孔局部填满画框，面部受强烈蓝、紫与橙色光照亮。没有独立背景；裁切贴得太近，眼睛、面颊、鼻梁与鼻孔本身构成全部场景。左上方深发和浓眉扫过一只清晰的绿金色虹膜。光亮眼球上有一点白色反光，眼睑与睫毛留着深藏蓝影。靠近右缘，另一只眼睛失焦，像一个柔绿圆点，落在清楚的鼻梁之外。面部中央浸在饱和电蓝色中，零散雀斑仍以较深记号分布于鼻子和面颊。一块炽热橙红色光斑在左脸颊发亮，碎成细小纹理亮点，显露毛孔与不规则皮肤表面。较窄的橙光轮廓掠过鼻右侧和近处脸缘。紫影填入左下与顶部，阻止暖色蔓延整幅。照明显然有方向且多彩：冷蓝打在中央平面，暖光擦过面颊和鼻缘，最深暗部聚在眉下和鼻孔周围。镜头让近处眼睛和皮肤肌理清晰，让远眼柔化，在极紧裁切中制造纵深。整体构图亲密而如电流，以互补色光和可触细节使一小块神情显得广阔。
style_prompt_en: A macro photographic style uses extreme proximity, shallow focus, and saturated colored light to turn small surface details into a large composition. Electric cobalt and ultraviolet violet occupy broad shadow areas; hot coral and orange strike selected raised textures, while a tiny green-gold or white highlight gives the image a sharp focal spark. The boundary between warm and cool light follows actual volume rather than a flat graphic divide. Fine speckles, pores, and glossy reflections remain crisp near the focus plane, then fall off quickly into soft colored blur. Dark edges compress the frame and intensify the luminous center. Multiple directional light sources create local highlights and deep recess shadows, with almost no neutral ambient color. The overall effect is immersive, tactile, and otherworldly, driven by optical depth and ultraviolet-like color contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 微距摄影风格借极近距离、浅焦和饱和色光，把细小表面细节放大为主要构图。电钴蓝和紫外紫占据宽阔阴影区，炽珊瑚和橙光落在选定的凸起纹理上，极小的绿金或白色亮点给予画面锋利焦点。暖冷光的边界沿真实体积行进，而非平面图形分隔。焦平面附近细斑、毛孔与光亮反射保持清晰，随后迅速退成柔软的彩色失焦。暗边压缩画框并加强发亮中心。多个定向光源制造局部高光与深凹暗影，几乎没有中性环境色。整体沉浸、可触且超现实，由光学纵深与紫外光般的色彩反差推动。
theme_en: An extreme close-up of a freckled face under blue and orange ultraviolet lighting
theme_zh: 布满雀斑的面孔在蓝橙紫外光下的极近特写
name: UV colors
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
